name: o55788

schema.description: Measurement report provided by a CBSD.

eutraCarrierRssiRpt.description: Report structured used by a CBSD when a measurement report type is EutraCarrierRssiNonTx or EutraCarrierRssiAlways

eutraCarrierRssiRptObject.description: Report for a particular Carrier RSSI measurement.

measFrequency.description: Frequency of the low end of the measured channel in Hz.

measBandwidth.description: Measurement bandwidth of the channel in Hz.

measCarrierRssi.description: Carrier RSSI measurement of the channel in dBm as per 3GPP TS 32.592.

description:
Please find below the latest carrier‑RSSI measurement report from the CBSD:

- For the channel whose low‑frequency edge is 1820 MHz (1 820 000 000 Hz) with a measurement bandwidth of 10 MHz (10 000 000 Hz), the observed carrier RSSI is –55.3 dBm.  
- For the channel whose low‑frequency edge is 1835 MHz (1 835 000 000 Hz) with a measurement bandwidth of 20 MHz (20 000 000 Hz), the observed carrier RSSI is –48.7 dBm.

These values reflect the most recent non‑transmit carrier RSSI readings and can be used for ongoing interference assessment and spectrum management.
